AvailabilityBlockId.description: Unique identifier of the [Availability block](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/availabilityblocks/#availability-block) which the availability adjustment belongs to.

ResourceCategoryId.description: Unique identifier of the [Resource category](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/resources/#resource-category) whose availability is updated.

StartUtc.description: Start of the interval in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

EndUtc.description: End of the interval in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

FirstTimeUnitStartUtc.description: Start of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the first [time unit](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/services/#time-unit), in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

LastTimeUnitStartUtc.description: End of the time interval, expressed as the timestamp for the start of the last [time unit](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/services/#time-unit), in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format.

UnitCount.description: Adjustment value applied on the interval.

ActivityState.title: Activity state
ActivityState.description:
Shows whether the availability adjustment is active or deleted.

Deleted

Active

ReleaseOverrideUtc.description: Exact moment the availability adjustment is released if set; overrides the release strategy of the associated availability block.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the adjustment in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

IsActive.description: Whether the availability adjustment is still active.

PaxCounts.description: Collection of predicted occupancy of availability adjustments. Relates to how many adjustments are assigned to each count of guests.

FirstTimeUnitReleaseUtc.description: Exact moment the first time unit of the availability adjustment is released based on `ReleaseOverrideUtc` or the `ReleaseStrategy` of the associated availability block, or the `OperationalEditableHistoryInterval` of the associated enterprise if not set, or `null` if `AvailabilityBlockId` is `null`.
